In the diagram, $M$ lies on the segment $KQ$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OK}=e$ and $\overrightarrow{OQ}=r$. The lengths satisfy $KM:MQ=5:11$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OM}$ in terms of $e$ and $r$."] ["c58fe7fd-c6c3-522a-81bc-ed05e0add385" :question/worked-solution "First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OK}=e\qquad \overrightarrow{OQ}=r .
$$

Trace the path from $K$ through $O$ to $Q$:

$$
\overrightarrow{KQ}=\overrightarrow{KO}+\overrightarrow{OQ}=-e+r.
$$

The ratio $KM:MQ=5:11$ gives $16$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{KM}=\frac{5}{16}\overrightarrow{KQ}=\frac{5}{16}(-e+r).
$$

Add along the path $O\to K\to M$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OM}&=\overrightarrow{OK}+\overrightarrow{KM}\\&=e+\frac{5}{16}(-e+r)\\&=\frac{11}{16}e+\frac{5}{16}r.\end{aligned}
$$"] ["c58fe7fd-c6c3-522a-81bc-ed05e0add385" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["c58fe7fd-c6c3-522a-81bc-ed05e0add385" :question/answer-fields "be5c8f68-3ec5-591b-8b52-5fbab5d9eb92"] [17592186096653 :knowledge-point/questions "c58fe7fd-c6c3-522a-81bc-ed05e0add385"]] "retractions" []}
